<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/v1/system/prune"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Exited containers and their logs, logs and overlays of containers that no longer exist, the
build cache and layers no image uses (both kept for an hour after they were written).
`images` also removes images no container uses, `volumes` named volumes no container mounts.
Running containers and what they use are never touched.
